metadata.environment: 远程容器 openEuler 24.03 LTS-SP4 aarch64, 预构建镜像 swr.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/ubscore/ubs-virt:oe2403-v1, Kunpeng-920 256核, NPU 910B3

image_source.selection_reason: Tier 1 业务预构建镜像: virt-awaresched BUILD.md 和 virt-optimizer 构建指导.md 均推荐此镜像, 镜像已在远程机器本地, 包含全部构建依赖(gcc12.3.1/cmake3.31/clang17/libbpf/rapidjson/libvirt-devel等)和CANN环境, 预置vmlinux.h

architecture.source: README.md, virt-optimizer/README.md, 远程机器 uname -m
architecture.value: aarch64 (Kunpeng-920), 同时支持 x86_64 和 aarch64

recommended_image.value: Tier 1 业务预构建镜像: swr.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com/ubscore/ubs-virt:oe2403-v1 (已在远程机器本地)

dockerfile_dependencies.value: FROM openeuler/openeuler:24.03-lts, 仅用于enpu-manager部署打包(非构建环境), 安装systemd和ca-certificates

dependencies.source: virt-awaresched BUILD.md, virt-optimizer README.md, vcann-rt CMakeLists.txt, enpu-manager spec
value: virt-awaresched: patch, libvirt-devel, libboundscheck, gcc-c++, gcc, cmake(>=3.22), make
vcann-rt: CANN环境(ASCEND_HOME_PATH), dcmi, gtest, mockcpp (构建和UT均需要CANN)
enpu-manager: CANN环境(ASCEND_HOME_PATH), ascendcl, dcmi, c_sec, cjson, cmake(>=3.15), gcc(>=9.3) (构建需要CANN)

build_commands.value: virt-awaresched: bash build.sh (Release) 或 bash build.sh package (RPM); virt-optimizer: bash build.sh (在virt-optimizer目录下); vcann-rt: source CANN set_env.sh && bash make_build.sh; enpu-manager: source CANN set_env.sh && cd core && bash make_build.sh && cd ../standalone && bash build.sh

ut_commands.source: virt-awaresched README.md, virt-optimizer README.md, vcann-rt build_ut.sh
ut_commands.value: virt-awaresched: bash build.sh test; virt-optimizer: cd virt-optimizer/ebpf && bash run_ut.sh; vcann-rt: bash build_ut.sh (需要CANN环境); enpu-manager: 无UT目录

special_dependencies.source: vcann-rt README.md, enpu-manager README.md, virt-optimizer 构建指导.md
value: NPU设备 910B3 (远程机器有5张,0号Critical其余Warning)
eBPF内核配置 CONFIG_DEBUG_INFO_BTF=y (virt-optimizer运行时需要,但预构建镜像内置vmlinux.h可解决构建输入)
预构建镜像内置 /usr/include/vmlinux.h (virt-optimizer构建用)

documentation_gaps.title: vcann-rt未明确标注CANN版本兼容性
documentation_gaps.body: vcann-rt README标注支持CANN 8.5.0和9.1.0, 但master分支代码在CANN 9.1.0下编译失败(kernel.c中struct aclrtDim3重定义). 文档未说明需使用哪个CANN版本构建, 也未提供版本切换指导

documentation_gaps.title: UT运行环境前置条件未充分说明
documentation_gaps.body: virt-awaresched的TestSocketClient需要socket服务端, virt-optimizer的VsockClientTest需要vsock设备, MonitorTest需要libvirt环境, vcann-rt的mem_limiter测试需要NPU设备正常状态. 文档未说明UT运行的前置环境要求
documentation_gaps.source: 各组件UT脚本和测试用例

documentation_gaps.title: enpu-manager缺少单元测试
documentation_gaps.body: enpu-manager组件没有test目录和UT脚本, README和贡献指南中也没有UT说明, 无法验证enpu-manager的单元测试

problems_encountered.problem: vcann-rt使用CANN 9.1.0构建失败: kernel.c中#define dim3 aclrtDim3导致struct aclrtDim3重定义, 与CANN 9.1.0的acl_rt.h冲突
problems_encountered.solution: 容器内同时安装了CANN 8.5.0和9.1.0。切换到CANN 8.5.0(source /usr/local/Ascend/cann-8.5.0/set_env.sh)重新构建成功。vcann-rt README标注支持CANN 8.5.0和9.1.0, 但当前master分支代码在9.1.0下编译不兼容
